content:
Latest update: Services appear to be gradually resuming, with some users able to access the platform again after roughly half an hour. Actual recovery times may vary by user.

You are not the only one affected. Claude, ChatGPT／Codex and Grok all appear to be experiencing major outages, impacting a large number of users.

The outage comes as OpenAI is building hype around the launch of GPT-6 Astra.

The issue affects the web, mobile and desktop versions of ChatGPT. Claude also appears to be facing the same outage. SpaceXAI has also confirmed that Grok is experiencing service disruptions.

The downtime comes amid reports that OpenAI may announce details of its next-generation large model Astra later today. The new model could see OpenAI's offering upgraded from GPT-5.6 to GPT-6.

We will update this story as more information becomes available.
